name: define stage gates D1..D8
purpose: src/query/gates.js lands as a new pure module beside delta.js. Every stage has one exported check function that takes (tree, context) and returns the { stage, gate, state, checks[] } shape section 2.4 pins. computeReadiness (TAC-4123) is the composer; every gate function is otherwise consumable in isolation for tests and for future viewers that render one stage. No I/O, no state, no time: the caller supplies ledgers, profile, freeze, delta, validate errors, probe count and coverage rollups.
responsibilities: src/query/gates.js: STAGE_ORDER = ['D1','D2','D3','D4','D5','D6','D7','D8']; STAGE_GATES map (D1 -> 'define.brief' etc.); INTERFACE_KINDS closed set matching proposal section 5.2; STAGE_SHORT_NAMES map (D1 -> 'brief' etc.).

checkD1Brief: intake acknowledged (brief-ledger has at least one statement since the freeze high-water mark), every statement kinded from BRIEF_KINDS, every openQuestion statement resolved or promoted to a decisions-ledger entry, profile.md carries surface (viewer | runningApp | prDiff) and register (productOwner | engineer | unstated) markers.

checkD2Skeleton: every 'capability' and 'constraint' statement in scope resolves to a REQ (via a REQ id in the statement's resolvedBy field OR by name-match against a REQ title, cheap check); every REQ in scope has non-TODO description, shapeClassification and domain; TAD.dataArchitecture.dataStores and TAD.dataArchitecture.coreEntities non-empty when any persistence REQ exists (per rcf-schemas 0.6.3 tad.schema.json; the top-level path was a slice-2 drift corrected under w-2026-09-25-dave-004); exactly one deploy or deferral ADR tree-wide (title prefix 'Deploy target:' or 'Deploy deferral:').
checkD3Shapes: every TAC in scope has at least one interface; every interface's kind is in INTERFACE_KINDS. Template markers, entity join, ownerRef resolution and path resolution are seams (0.30).

checkD4Stories: every REQ in scope has at least one US (fbsByAcId inversion via reqByUs is enough); every US in scope has a testable AC (ac.testable !== false and description non-empty), a failure AC or a project-scoped or req-scoped opt-out with baselineKey 'defineD4:failure', a must-not AC or an opt-out with baselineKey 'defineD4:mustNot', tacIds non-empty and every id resolving to a walker-known TAC, and no AC description containing the scaffold TODO placeholder pattern (case-sensitive uppercase 'TODO:' with a colon -- the literal shape src/core/store/init.js writes; incidental prose mentioning 'todo' does NOT trip the gate, and the validate CLI's broader whole-word notice stays separate).

checkD5Crosscut: TAD.securityArchitecture non-empty when tree carries any REQ with shape 'auth' or 'httpApi'; TAD.operationalConcerns non-empty when any AC description carries the '[deployed]' marker; every concern-ledger entry on a REQ in scope has disposition applied or waived (no status 'open').
checkD6Consistency: caller-supplied validateErrors is empty (tree-wide); caller-supplied probeOpenCount is zero.
checkD7Decisions: no decisions-ledger entry with status 'open'.

checkD8Freeze: prior stages passed | acknowledged at the current tree hash; every AC id owned by exactly one FBS (walker.fbsByAcId length 1); computeQueue.nextActionable is not null (queue head actionable) and the head's title is not 'TODO' or empty; validateErrors empty.

src/setup/identity-seed.js IDENTITY_TEMPLATE seeds a '## Surface' section carrying one of 'viewer' | 'runningApp' | 'prDiff' (default 'prDiff') so a fresh 'rcf init' project satisfies checkD1Brief's profile:surface marker without the operator editing profile.md first.

ADR-4126 (0.29.0): own the per-check persona and question map; export `CHECK_PERSONA`, `CHECK_QUESTION`, `STAGE_FALLBACK_PERSONA`, `checkPersona(name)`, `checkQuestion(name)` and `parseInterfaceDraft(iface)`. Every entry in `stages[].checks[]` carries `persona` (productOwner | engineer) and a non-empty `question`; the `stage:<D>:scope` placeholder uses `STAGE_FALLBACK_PERSONA`.

ADR-4126 (0.29.0): split `skeleton:reqFields` into `skeleton:reqIntent` (productOwner: description without TODO and domain, evaluated per REQ independently) and `skeleton:reqShape` (engineer: shapeClassification.shapes). Split `decisions:allAnswered` into `decisions:wellFormed` (productOwner: non-empty question + two or more options + a default naming one of them) and `decisions:allAnswered` (engineer: zero open).

ADR-4126 (0.29.0): new D3 check `shapes:draftSettled` fails any interface whose `description` starts with `[draft]` (whitespace tolerated), id `<tacId>:<name>`, over delta, total = interfaces on TACs in scope; `tacHasInterface` counts a draft as present; `kindVocabulary` applies to drafts.

`shapes:draftSettled` reports `[draft]` on `TAC.purpose`, `coreEntities[].description` and `TAC.interfaces[].description` with ids `<tacId>`, `TAD.entity:<name>` and `<tacId>:<name>` respectively (REQ-188, 0.30.0): `parseInterfaceDraft` reads the marker on all three homes with the same whitespace-tolerant rule; the draft pass enumerates across the three homes; nothing in the draft pass can fail a product-owner check.

`shapes:templateMarkers` (per-kind marker presence on `interfaces[].description`) (ADR-4131, 0.30.0 PR 5): engineer, over delta, id `<tacId>:<name>`, `why` names the missing marker; `recordShape` needs `fields:`; `httpRoute` needs `method`, `path`, `request`, `response`, `errors`; `fixture` needs `instances:`; `event` needs `payload:`; `cliCommand` needs `usage:`; `uiRoute` needs `path`; `port` needs `protocol`; `fileFormat` needs `format:`; `other` needs a note. Drafts are included (a `[draft]` recordShape without `fields:` fails exactly as a settled one).

`shapes:entityJoin` (every `coreEntities[].name` named by exactly one `recordShape`) (ADR-4131, 0.30.0 PR 5): engineer, over tree; match on `name` or an `entity:` line in the template; fail ids `TAD.entity:<name>` with `no record shape` or `N record shapes`.

`shapes:pathsResolve` (any `path:`-like token in an interface description that looks like a repo path resolves on disk or the description carries `authoredAt: D3`) (ADR-4131, 0.30.0 PR 5): engineer, over delta; gates stay pure, the readiness CLI resolves candidate paths and passes `resolvedPaths` in the stage context; ids `<tacId>:<name>` with the unresolved path in `why`.

`ackable(stage)` (ADR-4131, 0.30.0 PR 5): exported helper that returns `true` for D3, D5, D6 and `false` for every other stage. `stagePolicy(stage)` is unchanged; `ackable` is the companion that names the three gates that accept a recorded `--ack` override.
internalStructure: Every stage function follows the same shape: 1) decide notApplicable per section 3.2 and return { state: 'notApplicable' } with a single-check summary; 2) build checks[] as a list of { name, ok, over, pass, total, failing: [{ id, why }] }; 3) fold to state: 'passed' if every ok is true; 'failing' otherwise, unless the stage is D3/D5/D6 AND freeze.gates[<gate>].state === 'acknowledged' AND freeze.gates[<gate>].at.hash === currentTreeHash, in which case state is 'acknowledged'. Blocking-vs-warn is a property of the stage, not of the state: D3/D5/D6 use the acknowledged fold, D1/D2/D4/D7/D8 do not. The caller (readiness) folds the array of stage results into freezeable and nextAction.

interfaces.name: CHECK_PERSONA
interfaces.description: [draft] Owning persona map (productOwner | engineer) for every stage-gate check in 0.29.0 (ADR-4126).

interfaces.name: CHECK_QUESTION
interfaces.description: [draft] Per-check heading question in the owning persona's register; the report and the Readiness tab print it as the heading of each check's findings list.

interfaces.name: STAGE_FALLBACK_PERSONA
interfaces.description: [draft] Per-stage fallback persona for the `stage:<D>:scope` placeholder check that `notApplicable` envelopes carry.

interfaces.name: checkPersona
interfaces.description: [draft] Look up the owning persona for a check name; returns 'productOwner' | 'engineer' | null.

interfaces.name: checkQuestion
interfaces.description: [draft] Look up the question heading for a check name; returns the empty string when no question is registered.

interfaces.name: parseInterfaceDraft
interfaces.description: [draft] True when an interface's `description` carries the leading `[draft]` marker (whitespace tolerated).

interfaces.name: parseInterfaceTemplate
interfaces.description: [draft] moduleApi: parseInterfaceTemplate(iface) returns the per-kind marker presence for an interface: for a recordShape it reports whether `fields:` is present; for an httpRoute it reports whether each of method, path, request, response and errors is present; for fixture it reports `instances:`; for event, cliCommand, uiRoute, port, fileFormat and other it reports the per-kind markers from spec section 4 row 'D3 template parser'. Exported from src/query/gates.js for shapes:templateMarkers and for the validate step 6 notice (0.30.0 PR 5).

interfaces.name: ackable
interfaces.description: [draft] moduleApi: ackable(stage) returns true for D3, D5 and D6 and false for every other stage. The CLI readiness and freeze verbs read it to gate --ack as the recorded override for just those three gates (ADR-4131).

notes: Slice-3 hook (rcf define freeze): reads state to refuse on any 'failing'; --ack <gate> --reason <text> writes freeze.gates[<gate>] = { state: 'acknowledged', at: { hash: <currentTreeHash>, reason: <text>, by: <id> } } and re-runs computeReadiness to check freezeable. Slice-5 hook (viewer): reads the same object end-to-end.
